purpose: Remove the high-maintenance presentation-only introduction batch lifecycle and make the existing protected active-Plant Feed transaction the sole idempotent owner of missing roster-introduction rows without weakening authorization, data preservation, or context isolation.
success_outcome: The canonical eight roster introductions remain visible as the same non-agent-consumable UIFeedEvent rows, but no Plant-create, startup, batch, sink, digest, pending, or reconciliation path remains; an authorized active-Plant Feed open inserts only missing rows under current locks, repeat/concurrent/retry opens converge, archived reads and restore write nothing, existing rows remain unchanged, and the public Plant-create and Feed contracts are identical.
anti_goals: Do not change canonical roster membership/order/text, the UUIDv5 namespace/name grammar, introduction payload mapping, existing UIFeedEvent identity/timestamp/content, or agent-consumability flags.
Do not add a replacement batch table, materialization marker, pending state, repair status, worker, scheduler, outbox, startup/background scan, lifecycle, endpoint, response field, or cursor version.
Do not change classified Bus/UI publication, MessageEnvelope, agent context, Safety, Task, Companion, Plant-state, archive/grant policy, frontend/PWA, provider/model, or device behavior.
Do not rewrite the applied FT-008 migration or mutate historical TASK-031, TASK-032, TASK-033, TASK-045 lifecycle, protocols, verification, semantic review, checkpoint, or closure evidence.
Do not perform unrelated Agent Runtime, Agent Chat, migration, API, test, or documentation cleanup.

forbidden_scope: Canonical roster content/order/competence, provider/runtime request-result contracts, MessageEnvelope, classified publication semantics, or agent-context payload rules.
Safety Gate, ordinary/action Task, Companion Governance, Plant-state authority, dataset governance, frontend/PWA, external provider, or device-actuation behavior.
Public Plant-create or Feed request/response/error/order/cursor changes, new introduction persistence state, or background recovery operations.
Rewriting applied migration revisions or historical task/protocol/evidence artifacts for TASK-031, TASK-032, TASK-033, or TASK-045.
stop_conditions: The executor-confirmed Alembic head is not ft013_simplify_companion or a concurrent migration change cannot be reconciled by appending one forward revision without changing task dependencies or rewriting an applied migration.
Existing UIFeedEvent introduction rows cannot be preserved byte-for-byte in their stored identity, payload, created_at, uniqueness, FK, ordering, and consumability semantics.
Current Account, FarmMembership, applicable PlantAccessGrant, and active Plant cannot be locked/rechecked in the same transaction as missing-row insertion and Feed read.
The accepted outcome would require a new API/state/lifecycle/background repair mechanism, changing public Plant/Feed behavior, or widening another feature's authority.
Existing uncommitted work overlaps the required code, migration, or focused test surface in a way that cannot be reconciled without overwriting user-owned changes.

constraints: The primary owning capability and code root are Agent Chat Bus & UI Feed under backend/app/agent_chat; its application service owns lazy materialization, while API handlers only validate/translate and the composition root only wires the app.

Agent Runtime retains only the canonical roster and deterministic per-item introduction metadata builder; remove PlantAgentBootstrap command/service, batch/result/sink contracts, batch digest, and persistence/retry semantics.

Append one forward migration after the executor-confirmed current head, expected ft013_simplify_companion, that drops only agent_introduction_batches and advances every current exact-head consumer without editing an applied revision.

Preserve the existing no-leak query-validation and authorization precedence, then lock/recheck current Account, FarmMembership, Plant, and applicable grant in the same transaction as missing-row insertion and the subsequent Feed page read.

Insert only absent canonical roster-version-1 rows; deterministic ui_event_id plus existing plant_id/agent_id/roster_version uniqueness are the duplicate guards, and existing rows are never updated, replaced, or deleted.
Any insert/read/flush/commit failure rolls back the request and maps to FEED_PERSISTENCE_FAILED; a later authorized active Feed retry is the sole recovery path.

Remove Plant-create and startup composition calls/state plus obsolete batch/sink/reconciliation tests, and replace them with sole-trigger, data-preservation, authorization-race, concurrency, rollback/retry, and compatibility evidence.
invariants: Plant creation commits and returns the exact existing 201 PlantSummary without introduction, Feed, Bus, provider, or post-commit sink work.
Archived retained-history reads and restore are write-free; after restore, only a later currently authorized active-Plant Feed open may fill missing rows.
Introductions are immutable system presentation, never model output, MessageEnvelope, Agent Chat Bus events, agent context, Plant authority, Safety evidence, or REQ-011 provider evidence.
Existing Bus/UI publication, context isolation, literal-text behavior, retained-history access, response/order/cursor grammar, and no-store/error contracts remain compatible.
No secret, auth/session, provider payload, hidden reasoning, raw chat, or unapproved governance content enters rows, logs, responses, or evidence.
verification_targets: Migration/model tests prove the new single head, batch-table absence, retained UIFeedEvent rows and timestamps, unchanged constraints/indexes/FKs, and no new introduction lifecycle table.

PostgreSQL service tests prove zero/partial/all-existing materialization, deterministic missing-only inserts, repeat/concurrent/retry convergence, preservation of existing rows, and complete rollback on injected persistence failures.

HTTP/access tests prove Boss and granted Engineer/Consultant active Feed behavior, missing/revoked grant and archive races, read-only archived retained history, restore with zero writes, FEED_PERSISTENCE_FAILED then retry, and unchanged OpenAPI/response/order/cursor/no-store behavior.

Plant-create/startup tests and static scans prove zero introduction writes/calls plus absence of PlantAgentBootstrap, AgentIntroductionBatch/Result/Sink, content digest, PostgreSQLAgentIntroductionSink, reconcile_active_plants, startup reconciliation, and obsolete composition state.

Agent Runtime, Agent Chat, access, Safety, Task Follow-Up, Companion, Foundation database, exact-head, and full deterministic regressions prove no authority, context, data, or public-contract regression.
